sourceCompletion: Herdr idle observed before reading output; original session ended at usage limit after writing ten diagrams and SHOPIFY.txt. Its parser check remained unfinished.
scope: Deduplicated union of audit-cited primary text ranges, literal sed ranges, explicit corpus Read ranges, and line-addressed search results recovered from the main session and five audit subagents. Unnumbered/truncated snippets and dynamically generated ranges are not exhaustively recoverable. No entire file is inferred from a search or file listing.

tierRules.high: Evidence necessary to evaluate the core flywheel, GMV monetization/net take, capital allocation and FCF attribution, cohort and disclosure limitations, logistics costs and exit, international confounds, and AI causality/materiality.
tierRules.mid: Operating scale, financial reference tables and product, merchant, channel, buyer and partner mechanisms supporting or qualifying the core conclusion.
tierRules.low: Observed surrounding narrative, chronology, discovery/search hits not promoted by an audited claim, and secondary product history.

assignment: Partition of unique source lines. Shared evidence is assigned once to its highest claim importance. Up to two adjacent already observed lines inherit importance for local context. Tier names express importance, not credibility. Audits, diagrams, model answers and grades are excluded from model inputs.
limitations: The selection follows the original agent and may inherit its coverage gaps.

PDF-only cohort charts cannot be represented as sourceRange text. Original pixel estimates and causal conclusions are excluded; independent evals using these contexts alone cannot reproduce that visual analysis.

A search hit pins its complete original line, so it can contain more text than a clipped terminal result. Literal sed ranges preserve full original lines, including lines suppressed by downstream filters.
No model is selected or eval launched; capability/cost routing can be configured per tier in a later eval.
